newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Details of Argentine tax bill passed by deputies.
newsitem.headline: Details of Argentine tax bill passed by deputies.

text.p: The following is a breakdown of the tax package passed by the lower house of Argentina's Congress Wednesday, and sent on to the Senate:
* 46 percent increase in tax on diesel.
* 28.6 percent rise in tax on natural gas.
* 10 percent tax increase on diesel vehicles.
* Increase in income tax for companies to 33 percent from 30 percent, and for wage-earners on more than $120,000 a year also to 33 percent from 30 percent.
* Increase in the share of personal wealth tax going to the provinces, to 56 percent from 10 percent.
* Authorization for a $4.0 billion increase in government indebtedness for this year.
At the committee stage, deputies removed a proposed rise in the women's retirement age to 65 from 60, and extensions of value added tax.

Economy Minister Roque Fernndez said late Wednesday he hopes the package will be made law by year-end. Originally he expected it to boost the budget by $1.2 billion this year and $4-4.5 billion a year from 1997, but after being watered down at the committee stage its impact may have been halved.
